collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager is praised for stacking bowls, not for the clever work they did: say thank you, or mention the clever thing.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) worked very hard today on something difficult and clever, and nobody noticed. Then, at dinner, (friend) says, "That was a lovely way you stacked the bowls this morning. Very neat." Everyone agrees. The bowls. (subject) stacked the bowls without thinking, in about a breath.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "Thank you," says (subject). "Also, I fixed the water channel today. It took all morning." There's a pause. "Oh!" says (friend). "I wondered why the water was running better." Everyone is interested. They ask questions. They also, a moment later, go back to talking about the bowls.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "Thank you," says (subject). It's still nice to be praised. Even for bowls. Later, (subject.he/she) mentions the clever thing to (friend), who is impressed and says so. Now (subject) has been praised twice. Once for the right thing. It's a good evening after all.
